question: Under fixed model size, training budget, and total quantity-record budget, at what operation count does routing or exact execution cease to satisfy the frozen quantity gates while language preservation remains bounded?

five_operation_anchor.source: frozen Q2.6 seed-2 update-500 model; do not retrain it as a SAT-1 arm

readiness.unblock_rule: A separately preregistered five-operation repair candidate must preserve the existing quantity/replay result and pass zero-language-gate-v1. Mechanics-only inventory work may proceed, but no SAT-1 timing or training arm may launch before that anchor exists.

fixed_design.operation_inventory: one frozen nested inventory; the N-operation arm uses the first N registered operation ids
fixed_design.record_budget: identical total training, public, and promotion record counts at every N; counts are balanced across operation ids to within one record
fixed_design.optimizer_and_attempt_budgets: inherit Q2.6 unless a pre-execution amendment is separately reviewed and frozen
fixed_design.promotion_split: disjoint and opened exactly once after a jointly feasible public checkpoint

language_gate.timing: run once on the prospectively selected candidate for each arm after quantity selection
language_gate.decision_role: required for an arm to be promotion-eligible

stages.name: mechanics and timing
work: freeze the 160-operation inventory and nested manifests
prove deterministic replay, split isolation, and result validation
after the five-operation anchor is unblocked, measure one score-sealed AWS timing unit only under a separate hard budget
stages.advance_rule: the five-operation anchor is unblocked, all mechanics checks pass, score-sealed timing is complete, and a reviewed immutable Stage A budget exists

arms.source: reuse frozen Q2.6 seed-2 anchor; no retraining

decision_tree.five_fails_quantity_or_language: stop; the scaling study has no valid anchor
decision_tree.forty_or_160_fails_language: stop; record a language-preservation boundary, not a routing saturation result
decision_tree.160_passes_quantity_and_language: skip Stage B; no diagnostic transition is detected through 160 and Stage C may replicate only 5 and 160
decision_tree.five_passes_and_a_larger_arm_fails_quant: Stage B may localize the first failure

stages.name: transition localization
stages.conditional_on: Stage A finds a quantity failure above a valid 5-operation anchor while every arm through that failure passes the language gate
stages.selection_rule: sort all valid seed-2 arms by operation count and select the adjacent highest passing and lowest failing quantity arms; do not substitute an arm after seeing replication outcomes

stages.name: two-endpoint replication

conditional_design.no_transition_through_160: replicate operation counts 5 and 160 on seeds 1 and 3
conditional_design.localized_transition: replicate the two prospectively selected adjacent bracket counts on seeds 1 and 3

stages.family_rule: a count is confirmed only if all three declared seeds pass every frozen public, promotion, replay, and language gate; execute all four authorized replication arms even if an earlier arm fails

primary_outputs: operation and exact-artifact accuracy by count and seed
replay regression by count and seed
BLiMP and TinyStories preservation decisions by count and seed
the predeclared transition-bracket or no-transition-through-160 conclusion
